why: B forms a calm, light palette (light gray sofa, neutral flatweave rug, pale wood table, white console, white curtains) with a warm terracotta tassel cushion as the color accent, which suits the bright modern living room. A's bold black-and-white geometric rug, dark walnut chevron TV cabinet and busy patterned pillows compete with each other and with the light wood table, and the cabinet is only 43 cm deep. B's 174 cm console is a bit long but still fits opposite the sofa.
